name: Seed default labels
description: Fresh databases now get a small built-in label set (feature, bug, and a few others). Re-running the seed skips names that already exist.

steps.title: Built-in labels
steps.body: This is the catalog that ships with the app. Feature and bug are the ones you asked for. The rest are the usual issue-tracker set: improvement, docs, chore, performance, and security. Each row has a color so chips can render later without another lookup.

callouts.body: Names include the emoji, matching `💡 feature` / `🐞 bug`.
`onConflictDoNothing` on `name` makes this safe to run on every labels GET and via `pnpm db:seed`.

steps.title: Unique label names
steps.body: The conflict target only works if `name` is unique. That is also the right model: two labels named `🐞 bug` would be indistinguishable in the picker.

callouts.body: Unique on `name` is what `onConflictDoNothing({ target: labels.name })` keys off.

steps.title: Seed on first fetch
steps.body: The labels API is the only place the app reads this table today, so seeding here means a new database fills itself without a separate setup step.

callouts.body: Runs once per process after the first successful insert, then becomes a no-op.

steps.title: Local db scripts
steps.body: `db:push` applies the unique constraint. `db:seed` inserts the catalog into an existing database (already run against `local.db`).

diff --git a/src/lib/db/schema.ts b/src/lib/db/schema.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/db/schema.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import { index, int, sqliteTable, text, uniqueIndex } from "drizzle-orm/sqlite-core";
+import { PRIORITIES, STATUSES } from "../constants";
+
+function defaultFields() {
+	return {
+		createdAt: int({ mode: "timestamp_ms" })
+			.notNull()
+			.$defaultFn(() => new Date()),
+		updatedAt: int({ mode: "timestamp_ms" })
+			.notNull()
+			.$defaultFn(() => new Date())
+			.$onUpdateFn(() => new Date()),
+	};
+}
+
+export const teams = sqliteTable("teams", {
+	...defaultFields(),
+	id: int().primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
+	name: text().notNull(),
+	shortHand: text().notNull().unique(),
+});
+
+export const labels = sqliteTable("labels", {
+	...defaultFields(),
+	id: int().primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
+	name: text().notNull().unique(),
+	description: text().notNull(),
+	color: text().notNull(),
+});
+
+export const issues = sqliteTable(
+	"issues",
+	{
+		...defaultFields(),
+		// <team-slug>-000
+		id: int().primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
+		teamId: int().notNull(),
+		title: text().notNull(),
+		body: text().notNull(),
+		status: text({ enum: STATUSES }).notNull(),
+		priority: text({ enum: PRIORITIES }).notNull().default("None"),
+		assignee: int(),
+		assignedAt: int({ mode: "timestamp_ms" }),
+	},
+	(table) => [
+		index("team_idx").on(table.teamId),
+		index("status_idx").on(table.status),
+		index("priority_idx").on(table.priority),
+		index("assignee").on(table.assignee),
+	],
+);
+
+export const issueLabels = sqliteTable(
+	"issueLabels",
+	{
+		...defaultFields(),
+		id: int().primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
+		issueId: int(),
+		labelId: int(),
+	},
+	(table) => [
+		index("issue_id_idx").on(table.issueId),
+		uniqueIndex("issue_labels_unique_idx").on(table.issueId, table.labelId),
+	],
+);
